hookups.source: No operator page states it: the township's parks-and-recreation page (the entry's website) is unedited Wix template text ('I'm a paragraph. Click here to add your own text...'), the township home page has no campground content, the older breentwp.gov domain no longer resolves, and Google Maps ('Stromberg Township Park', 4.4 stars / 9 reviews) lists no website or phone (all read 2026-10-25). The stored 50-amp was derived from note prose resting on directory listings, so it is cleared.

sites.source: Same as hookups: no township page gives a site count (read 2026-10-25); the stored 20 was derived from note prose resting on directory listings, so it is cleared.

facilities.source: Same as hookups: no township page mentions a dump station (read 2026-10-25); the derived value rested on directory listings, so it is cleared.

booking.source: Same as hookups: no township page says how sites are taken (read 2026-10-25); the derived first-come values rested on directory listings, so they are cleared.

note: Breen Township park on the Sturgeon River's Hardwood Impoundment near Foster City in the western U.P. Directory listings (not the township) describe about 20 first-come sites, some with electric, plus swimming and ORV trail access. The township's website has no campground page. --Claude
summary: No operator page exists for the campground: breentownship.com's parks-and-recreation page is unedited Wix template text, the home page carries only board contacts, minutes and zoning, and the old breentwp.gov domain is gone (NXDOMAIN). Google Maps shows 'Stromberg Township Park' (4.4 stars, 9 reviews) with no phone or website. Cleared the derived 50-amp electric, 20-site count, dump station and FCFS values (they rested on directory listings; Campendium even says 5 electric sites, $20 electric / $10 non-electric, cash or check, read only as a lead). Fees left empty.
flags: Missing website: the entry's https://www.breentownship.com/about/committees/parks-and-recreation is unedited Wix template placeholder text (nothing about Stromberg Park), and no other township page covers the campground (read 2026-10-25). No operator page found anywhere.
Phone 906-282-3116 is not on any township page; the township lists Supervisor 906-271-0108, Clerk 906-282-4707 and Treasurer 906-246-3322 (https://www.breentownship.com/). Google Maps lists no phone.

Inclusion lead: the only details are directory listings (Campendium: ~20 sites, 5 electric, port-a-potties, hand-pump water, 'mostly primitive', no reservations; a 2019 Iron Mountain Daily News article on a DNR grant to renovate it with 15 new sites and a dump station). No page states RV site sizes; the 23-ft fit and live web presence are unconfirmed.
